deed: צה"ל פינה מסוריה לירדן מאות אנשים, אנשי 'הקסדות הלבנות' ובני משפחותיהם, ב-2018
title: The IDF escorted hundreds of evacuees, "White Helmets" rescuers and their families, from Syria to Jordan, 2018

trailer.text: The White Helmets, or Syrian Civil Defense, are a group of volunteers who rescue Syrians wounded in attacks on rebel-held areas, and according to the Times of Israel they gained international renown for rescuing victims from rubble.

At the request of the United States, Canada and European countries, the IDF escorted the members of the organization and their families through Israel to Jordan on the night between Saturday and Sunday.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said that these were people who had saved lives and were in mortal danger, and that he had therefore approved their passage as a humanitarian gesture.
According to the Jordanian news agency Petra, Britain, Germany and Canada agreed to take in the evacuees.

glance.label: Who acted
glance.value: The IDF, under the direction of the Israeli government

glance.label: From where to where
glance.value: From Quneitra near the Golan Heights, through Israel, to Jordan

glance.label: At the request of
glance.value: The United States, Canada and European countries

paragraphs.text: The White Helmets, or Syrian Civil Defense, are a group of volunteers who rescue Syrians wounded in attacks on rebel-held areas.
According to VOA, the organization was founded in 2013 as a network of first responders who rescue wounded people after airstrikes and other attacks.

According to Walla, the organization was founded in 2013, two years after the war began, but the article contradicts itself on the number of fatalities: in one place it states that about 200 of its members have been killed since, and in another about 300.
According to the Times of Israel, the organization gained international renown for rescuing victims from rubble after regime airstrikes.
The British Foreign Secretary and the International Development Secretary stated that the White Helmets saved more than 115,000 lives during the Syrian conflict.

According to Ynet, which attributes the figure to a statement by the U.S. State Department spokesperson, the organization's activists have saved more than one hundred thousand people since the fighting began.
According to Walla, the organization was mentioned as a candidate for the Nobel Peace Prize.
According to American officials, the organization enjoyed backing from the United States and Western countries for years.
According to NPR, the United States contributed some $30 million in assistance to it, and Britain and other countries also contributed.
Since June 2018 the Syrian army and its allies have been on an offensive in southern Syria.
According to the Jerusalem Post, Jordan refused to take in more refugees as the regime took over Deraa and the border areas, in late June and early July.
The civil defense members were trapped in Quneitra, which borders the Golan Heights.
According to the Jerusalem Post, they learned that they would not be allowed to move north to opposition areas in Idlib.
The Syrian regime and its supporters have called the White Helmets terrorists, Western-supported propagandists and Islamists.
According to NPR, the Syrian government and Russia labelled them foreign "agents" and accused them of staging chemical attacks.
According to ynet, Assad and his supporters had long accused the organization of ties with Israel and the West.
According to the Jerusalem Post, Syrian intelligence agents were already compiling lists of names to hunt down enemies of the regime.
The newspaper wrote that the organization's members faced torture or worse if caught.
The organization itself stated that leaving was the only alternative, and that otherwise they would have faced detention or death at the hands of the Syrian regime and its ally Russia.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said that he assisted in the evacuation at the request of US President Donald Trump and other Western leaders.
According to the Canadian Press, Netanyahu said that Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau was among those who personally asked him for this.
According to the Jerusalem Post, it took personal calls from Trump and Trudeau to Netanyahu to secure the agreement.
According to the Jerusalem Post, US Ambassador to Israel David Friedman worked closely with the Israeli government, the State Department and the National Security Council.
Evacuation plans were accelerated after the NATO summit in Brussels, in the week before the evacuation.
According to the German newspaper Bild, as reported by Sputnik, the evacuation was negotiated between the United States, Russia and the Syrian authorities.
The Jordanian news agency Petra stated that the kingdom authorized the UN to organize the passage of Syrian citizens through Jordan for resettlement in Western countries.
According to the Jerusalem Post, the key to Jordan's agreement was a special legal assurance that the White Helmets would move on to the West.
Netanyahu said that these were people who had saved lives and were in mortal danger, and that he had therefore approved their passage through Israel as an important humanitarian gesture.

stations.title: The night: buses to the Jordan border

paragraphs.text: According to VOA, they traveled on the night between Saturday and Sunday by bus, accompanied by Israeli police and UN vehicles.
According to ynet, the move was carried out in secrecy so as not to endanger the lives of the Syrian activists.
The IDF said that it acted in an “out of the ordinary” gesture due to an immediate risk to the lives of the civilians.
According to VOA, the evacuation, which the report described as the first of its kind, was carried out at the request of the United States, Canada and European countries, according to the IDF.
According to the Jerusalem Post, a Bild reporter followed the buses to the Jordan border and tweeted photos of the border crossing at 5 a.m.
According to the Jerusalem Post, because of roadblocks and fighting against ISIS, fewer people were actually evacuated than planned.
The US State Department spokeswoman said that more than half of the evacuees are children.
On Sunday the IDF Spokesperson announced that it had completed the humanitarian effort.
The IDF said that Israel continues its policy of non-intervention in the Syrian conflict and holds the Syrian regime responsible for everything that happens in Syrian territory.

stations.title: After the border: three months in Jordan

paragraphs.text: According to Petra, the evacuees would remain in a closed area in Jordan.
Britain, Germany and Canada agreed to take them in within three months.
Jordanian Foreign Ministry spokesman Mohammad al-Kayed confirmed that they would remain in Jordan for three months.
The US State Department spokeswoman said that they were allowed to enter Jordan on a transit basis.
The German Interior Ministry said that it would offer protection to some of the volunteers and their families.
The EU foreign policy chief, Federica Mogherini, said that the EU recognizes the essential efforts of Israel, of Jordan and of others who contributed to moving the White Helmets to a safe place.
British Foreign Secretary Jeremy Hunt tweeted thanks to Israel and Jordan for acting quickly on the request of Britain and its friends.
Jason Greenblatt, Trump's envoy, wrote in a tweet that the IDF deserves special commendation for the operation.
The US State Department stated that the United States welcomes the evacuation.
According to the Jerusalem Post, this was an unprecedented level of international cooperation, with the support of Canada, Britain, Germany and the United States.
According to Israel Hayom, the operation was unprecedented.

The commander of the Good Neighbor Directorate, Lt. Col. A., said that it was moving to receive families, mainly women and children, who crossed at first in fear, but when they reached the border their eyes shone with happiness.
According to a source who spoke with NPR, one of the evacuees broke a leg on the way.
According to the same source, a woman gave birth moments before the border was crossed.
Raed Saleh, head of the White Helmets, confirmed that the evacuation took place.
He declined to specify how many people got out.
On Monday, the Syrian government condemned the evacuation carried out with the help of Israeli soldiers, calling it a criminal operation.
According to Arutz Sheva (Channel 7), in their statement the White Helmets thanked the countries that assisted, but did not mention Israel.
According to the Jerusalem Post, the operation is seen as a success, but it also reflects the failure of the Western powers to stymie Assad's offensive.
Julian Roepcke, a journalist with Bild, noted that while the success was being cheered, the Russian air force was flying supplies from France to Latakia, to regime areas.
Thousands of members of the organization remained in Syria after the evacuation.
According to a source who spoke with NPR, there are currently no plans to also evacuate the civil defense members who remained in northern Syria.

disagreements.question: How many people were actually evacuated?

versions.says: Times of Israel: some 400 members of the organization and their families
US State Department spokeswoman: more than 400
Jerusalem Post: 422 and not 800, because of roadblocks and fighting against ISIS, after an estimate of about 800
Source who spoke with NPR: only 422 managed to get out, because of heavy fighting
Jordanian Foreign Minister Ayman Safadi, according to AP: 422 volunteers, and not the 800 initially cleared
Jordanian government source to Reuters: 422, compared with 800 announced earlier
The White Helmets: 98 volunteers and 324 of their family members

disagreements.question: How many volunteers, without family members, were among the evacuees?

versions.says: Jerusalem Post: 90 members of the White Helmets

disagreements.question: How many members of the organization remained in Syria?
How many of the evacuees will Germany receive?

versions.says: German Interior Ministry: eight volunteers and their families
Bild, as reported in ynet: 50 of the organization's people will receive asylum-seeker status in Berlin

claims.text: משרד הפנים הגרמני אמר שיעניק הגנה לשמונה מתנדבי הקסדות הלבנות ולבני משפחותיהם.
claims.quote: The German Interior Ministry said it would offer protection to eight White Helmet volunteers and their families.

claims.text: דובר משרד הפנים הגרמני אמר שגרמניה תעניק מקלט לשמונה פעילי הקסדות הלבנות ובני משפחותיהם.
claims.quote: דובר מטעם משרד הפנים הגרמני אמר כי גרמניה תעניק מקלט לשמונה פעילי

claims.text: הממונה על מדיניות החוץ של האיחוד האירופי פדריקה מוגריני אמרה שהאיחוד מכיר במאמצים החיוניים של ישראל וירדן ושל אחרים שתרמו להעברת הקסדות הלבנות למקום בטוח.
claims.quote: The EU recognizes the essential efforts of Israel and Jordan, and of all others

claims.text: שר החוץ הבריטי ג'רמי האנט צייץ תודה לישראל ולירדן על פעולה מהירה לבקשת בריטניה וידידותיה.
claims.quote: thank you Israel and Jordan for acting so quickly on our request

claims.text: ג'ייסון גרינבלט, שליחו של טראמפ, כתב בציוץ שלצה"ל מגיעה הוקרה מיוחדת על המבצע.
claims.quote: The Israel Defense Forces deserve special commendation for this

claims.text: דוברת מחלקת המדינה האמריקאית הת'ר נאואר מסרה שארה"ב מברכת על פינוי של יותר מ-400 חברי ההגנה האזרחית הסורית ובני משפחותיהם מדרום-מערב סוריה.
claims.quote: The United States welcomes the safe evacuation of more than 400 members of the Syrian Civil Defense, otherwise known as the White Helmets, and their families from southwest Syria.

claims.text: לפי הג'רוזלם פוסט, פינוי מאות אנשים מסוריה לישראל בתמיכת קנדה, בריטניה, גרמניה וארה"ב היה רמה חסרת תקדים של שיתוף פעולה בינלאומי.
claims.quote: Evacuating hundreds of people from Syria into Israel with the support of Canada, the UK, Germany and the US was an unprecedented level of international cooperation.

claims.text: לפי ישראל היום, המבצע חסר התקדים בוצע לבקשת ארה"ב וחלק מבעלות בריתה האירופיות של ישראל.
claims.quote: The unprecedented operation was carried out at the request of the United States and some of Israel's European allies.

claims.text: מפקד מנהלת שכנות טובה, סגן-אלוף א', סיפר שהיה מרגש לקלוט משפחות, בעיקר נשים וילדים, שהגיעו לגבול בחשש.
claims.quote: אין ספק כי היה מרגש לעמוד על גדר הגבול ולקלוט משפחות - בעיקר נשים וילדים - שעוברות בתחילה בחשש

claims.text: לפי הגורם שדיבר עם NPR, בין המפונים היה מי ששבר רגל בדרך ואישה שילדה רגעים לפני שנחצה הגבול.
claims.quote: The evacuees included someone who broke a leg en route, and a mother who gave birth just moments before she was taken across the border.

claims.text: ראאד סאלח, ראש הקסדות הלבנות, אישר שהפינוי התרחש אך סירב לפרט כמה אנשים יצאו.
claims.quote: Raed Saleh, the head of the Syrian Civil Defense, as the White Helmets are formally called, confirmed the evacuations took place but would not elaborate on the numbers of people who got out.

claims.text: ממשלת סוריה גינתה ביום שני את הפינוי בסיוע חיילים ישראלים וכינתה אותו "מבצע פלילי".
claims.quote: The Syrian government on Monday condemned the evacuation of hundreds of Syrian White Helmet rescue workers and their families with the help of Israeli soldiers

claims.text: לפי ערוץ 7, בהודעתם הודו הקסדות הלבנות למדינות שסייעו אך לא הזכירו את ישראל.
claims.quote: The White Helmets thanked the countries which assisted in the operation but did not mention Israel, which assisted in the operation

claims.text: לפי הג'רוזלם פוסט, המבצע נתפס כהצלחה אך משקף גם את כישלון המעצמות המערביות לבלום את מתקפת אסד.
claims.quote: The operation is seen as a success, but the reality is that it also reflects the failure of Western powers to stymie Assad's offensive.

claims.text: עיתונאי בילד ג'וליאן רופקה העיר שבזמן שהריעו להצלחה, חיל האוויר הרוסי הטיס אספקה מצרפת ללטקיה לאזורי המשטר.
claims.quote: Julian Roepcke, a journalist with Bild noted that even as people were cheering the success, the Russian air force was flying supplies from France to Latakia for Syrian-regime controlled areas.

claims.text: לפי NPR, לאחר הפינוי נותרו בסוריה יותר מ-3,000 חברי ארגון.
claims.quote: After this evacuation, there remain more than 3,000 members in the country

claims.text: בהודעת הארגון נמסר ש-3,750 חברי הקסדות הלבנות נשארו לעבוד בשטח בסוריה.
claims.quote: 3750 White Helmets remain working on the ground in Syria to do so.

claims.text: לפי הגורם שדיבר עם NPR, אין כרגע תוכניות לפנות גם את אנשי ההגנה האזרחית שנשארו בצפון סוריה.
claims.quote: For now, the source close to the evacuations told NPR, there are no plans to evacuate them too.

claims.text: לפי הג'רוזלם פוסט, מדובר לא רק ב-90 חברי הקסדות הלבנות אלא גם בבני משפחותיהם, בהערכה של כ-800 איש.
claims.quote: it was not just 90 members of the White Helmets, but also their families, an estimated 800 people

claims.text: לפי גורם המקורב למבצע שדיבר עם NPR, רק 422 איש הצליחו לצאת מסוריה בגלל לחימה כבדה בשטח.
claims.quote: The informed source close to the operation told NPR that only 422 people actually made it out of the country, because of heavy fighting on the ground.

claims.text: לפי AP, שר החוץ הירדני איימן ספדי אמר שפונו 422 מתנדבים ולא 800 שאושרו תחילה.
claims.quote: Foreign Minister Ayman Safadi said 422 White Helmets volunteers were evacuated, instead of the initial 800 cleared for the operation

claims.text: לפי גורם ממשלתי ירדני שדיבר עם רויטרס, 422 איש הובאו מסוריה, לעומת 800 שהוכרזו קודם על ידי משרד החוץ בעמאן.
claims.quote: The source said 422 people were brought from Syria, down from a figure of 800 announced earlier by the foreign ministry in Amman.

claims.text: לפי VOA, ירדן אמרה תחילה ש-800 חולצו ותיקנה אחר כך את המספר ל-422.
claims.quote: Initially, Amman said 800 were rescued, but later corrected the figure to 422.

claims.text: לפי הודעת הקסדות הלבנות, 98 מתנדבים ו-324 מבני משפחותיהם, בעיקר נשים וילדים, הגיעו לירדן דרך רמת הגולן הסורית הכבושה.
claims.quote: 98 male and female White Helmet volunteers, with 324 of their family members - mostly women and children - have arrived in Jordan through the occupied Syrian Golan Heights

claims.text: לפי ישראל היום, צה"ל חילץ כ-800 חברי הקסדות הלבנות ובני משפחותיהם מדרום-מערב סוריה לירדן.
claims.quote: The Israeli military recently extracted some 800 members of Syria's White Helmets civil defense group and their families, evacuating them to Jordan from southwest Syria.

claims.text: לפי בילד כפי שדווח ב-ynet, 50 מאנשי הארגון שפונו יקבלו מעמד של מבקשי מקלט בברלין.
claims.quote: 50 מאנשי הארגון שפונו על ידי ישראל לסוריה יקבלו מעמד של מבקשי מקלט בברלין
